# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 5 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in 1QH Column 5 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 5:1 — "gur" — "sojourned" vs. "dwelt" vs. "lived as a stranger"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "sojourned" | Literal gur |
| LOGOS | "dwelt" | Simplified formal |
| PNEUMA | "lived as a stranger" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "sojourned." Preserves the loaded biblical term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 5:2 — "mezimmot yitsri" — "schemes" vs. "designs"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "schemes of my inclination" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "designs of my inclination" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "the traps my own nature sets" | Dynamic paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "designs of my inclination." Slightly more neutral.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:3 — verb choice — "helped" vs. "preserved" vs. "rescued"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "helped my life from the pit" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "preserved my life from the pit" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "rescued my life from the pit" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "preserved my life from the pit."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:7 — "mishpat" — "judgment" vs. "justice"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "for judgment" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "for the sake of judgment" | Expanded |
| PNEUMA | "for the sake of justice" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "for the sake of judgment." Mishpat here means divine adjudication.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:12 — "Torah" vs. "Law" vs. "Instruction"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Your Torah" | Hebrew preserved |
| LOGOS | "Your Law" | Standard English |
| PNEUMA | "Your Instruction" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "Your Torah" (EMET). Consistent with DSS convention.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 5:15 — "'ani" — "poor one" vs. "afflicted one"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the poor one" | Traditional Psalmic |
| LOGOS | "the afflicted one" | Emphasizes suffering |
| PNEUMA | "this poor one" | Dynamic demonstrative |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "the poor one." Echoes the Psalms.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 5:20 — "matsref" — "crucible" vs. "refining-pot"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the crucible" | Standard |
| LOGOS | "the refining-pot" | Descriptive |
| PNEUMA | "the crucible" | Standard |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the crucible" (EMET/PNEUMA). More vivid.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/PNEUMA.

---

## 5:24 — storm-calm imagery

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "turn the storm to a calm" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "turn the tempest to a stillness" | Elevated |
| PNEUMA | "turned the raging storm to stillness" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted a blend: "turn the tempest to a calm."

**Status:** Resolved as SOPHIA blend.

---

## 5:25 — "pi arayot" — "mouth" vs. "jaws"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the mouth of lions" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "the jaws of lions" | More vivid |
| PNEUMA | "the jaws of lions" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the jaws of lions" (LOGOS/PNEUMA). More evocative.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

**Total disagreements in Column 5: 9**
